Message:
Fenrir, Cerberus...
I’m sure the two o’ yuh
are just fine...right...?

Great Dragon God...
Please, protect everyone
in my place...!

A-Are yuh tellin’ me to
go save ’em myself,
Great Dragon God?!

But, me prayin’ like this
is the most I can do...!

Huh...?!
The wind suddenly picked up...!
...I can hear somethin’
on the wind...

At this rate, just like before,
the two o’ them’ll be...!
...I know that,
but my legs won’t move...!

This is just the same
as last time...
All I ever did...
was shut down
an’ run away...!

I always heard the rollin’ thunder
on that mountain in Lupus—
the very cries o’ Cerberus...

Yet, I’m still
too scared to move...!

“Of course I feel scared.
But, I still fight because
I just can’t turn my back
on those in need.”

Oh yeah...!
That’s what the Duke said...

Just by wantin’ to save people,
he can always jump
straight into danger...!

I want to be like that, too...!
Because... Because...!

“I’m sick o’ only ever runnin’,
an’ losin’ the friends
I love most...!”
